title: Generalized Fermat equation over cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_l$-extensions of totally real fields
summary: Let $K$ be a totally real number field of odd degree in which $2$ is inert. Let $l \geq 5$ be a prime with $l \nmid [K:\mathbb{Q}]$ and $\gcd(\frac{l-1}{2}, [K:\mathbb{Q}])=1$. We prove that if $2$ is inert in $K$, $l$ is non-Wieferich, i.e., $2^{l-1} \not\equiv 1 \pmod{l^2}$, and $l$ is totally ramified in $K$, then the asymptotic Fermat's Last Theorem holds over each $n$-th layer $K_{n,l}$ of the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_l$-extension of $K$.
